reviews.text: JBS is a fabulous tree service. Justin, Brian and the entire crew including Kara in the office couldn't be more professional. On time - everytime - and no surprises. Their fleet of vehicles is impressive and they price extremely fairly. I can't say enough good things about them!

reviews.author: Cody Butryn
reviews.text: I had JBS remove several large difficult trees on my property. The experience was wonderful from start to finish. They came on time. Professionally and neatly navigated the tree removal. Thoroughly cleaned everything up. Great guys! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Donald Rogers Jr.
reviews.text: Chris and crew were phenomenal. From the first call to the end of the job very responsive and supportive. Crew was promptly on time and walked the property to give a final review of the job. Finished quickly, cleaned up nice, and price was great. Would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Zombie Autopsy
reviews.text: They did a great job, We're very professional. Were reasonably priced. I took the really big pieces shredded the brush and took the stump all the way down. Cleaned up everything nicely stacked the leftover wood and fixed the big divots that were left.

reviews.author: Paul Pham
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a tree company, stop searching. This is the one. I don’t usually write reviews, but this company truly deserves it. From the very beginning, I felt like I was dealing with honest professionals who genuinely care about their customers. Paddy came to my house for the estimate, and he was punctual, knowledgeable, respectful, and never pressured me. The price was incredibly fair, honestly, I don’t think you could find better value for the quality of work they provide. (I called 10 companies for estimate) Before hiring them, I personally took the time to verify that they carried all the proper insurance because protecting my home and my family was very important to me. Everything checked out, which gave me complete peace of mind. I also had the pleasure of speaking with Kara in the office. She was kind, patient, professional, and made the entire process smooth from start to finish. I found this company because of their excellent online reviews, and now I understand why they have earned such a great reputation. I am a real customer, and I couldn’t be happier with my decision. The entire crew was hardworking, professional, and treated my property with respect. If I could give this company 1,000 stars instead of five, I absolutely would. I have no connection to them other than being an extremely satisfied customer. They earned my trust, my respect, and my highest recommendation. Thank you all for making what could have been a stressful project such a wonderful experience. I hope everyone looking for a trustworthy tree company gets to experience the same confidence and peace of mind that I did. Paul from Beachwood NJ

reviews.author: Allysa Weintraub
reviews.text: They are the best. I’ve been through a few diff tree company’s but this is the 1st one that I’ve now used twice and still am very happy with. They were professional from estimate to project to cleanup !!! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Paul Racioppo
reviews.text: Kara was very responsive in getting the appointments scheduled. Ryan came to assess the job and his crew was absolutely professional, well trained in cutting large branches - largest oak tree in Holliday City, and they cut any branch I wanted. They cleaned up right down to the leaves on the ground. I was very pleased with their work. Pictures show the before and after.

reviews.author: Deb Mac Donald
reviews.text: They worked very efficiently and respectful of the property and surroundings. The work was done very well and the clean up afterwards was meticulous. We would definately recommend them to anyone needing tree work done. Also their cost was very competitive and they offered options as to which services would best suit our situation and spending limits.

reviews.author: Chuck Tegano
reviews.text: Everyone at JBS was professional and polite! Their estimate was competitive, they showed up on time a left the place as clean as was before cutting down a few trees, stumping one of them, trimming a few others! I would highly recommend JBS Tree Experts to anyone looking for a reliable, fairly priced, professional, and friendly, tree service!

reviews.author: Karen Torick
reviews.text: We had extensive tree damage after the recent blizzard. JBS came out and removed the trees immediately. Their price was extremely reasonable and the crew was fantastic. We will be calling them again soon for Spring trimming. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Scott Wilberg
reviews.text: Too much praise and don't know where to start but extremely impressed with my tree removal from start to finish. The crew showed up on time and left my entire property much cleaner after the job. Very professional company to deal with from start to finish and would highly recommend. Thanks Nick!

reviews.author: Maria Trabucco
reviews.text: Kara, Ryan & the entire JBS crew are the best! They had done some work for us over the summer. They were prompt, professional & did a wonderful job! This past Wed w/ the flooding and high winds, we had a very large oak tree uproot and fall on our house. Once again, Kara & Ryan were there to help. The professionalism and outstanding customer service are something you just don’t find anymore these days. They were out w/i 10 min of my call and their fabulous team had this tree removed and off of our house down to the last twig! I can’t sing their praises enough and will never use anyone else. Keep up the great work!

reviews.author: Brian Berner
reviews.text: Wow, is all I have to say. I called JBS and I got Cara who set up my appointment with Paddy. They’re the real superstars here And the crew did an amazing job that left me and my wife speechless. If you’re looking for a Tree company, this is your place to be

reviews.author: Kelly gale
reviews.text: When we had a tree snap on father’s day weekend we got a call back and estimate in 24hours of calling and they worked around our schedule to get tree down and completely cleaned up quickly. Highly recommend JBS for any tree needs you have. Entire staff was Professional from start to finish of our job.

reviews.author: Brad Power
reviews.text: Awesome job by Jbs, came in removed two huge oak trees in my yard. In and out under 4 hours. Left me a pile of oak to split for later on. Cleaned up and even removed the tire marks on my lawn from their equipment. Great pricing too. 10/10 will use them and suggest them in the future

reviews.author: Tracy Denora
reviews.text: I was very happy with the service. The guys were fantastic. They put everything back that they had to move and they cleaned up after themselves very well. I highly recommend JBS.

reviews.author: Richard Busichio
reviews.text: They did excellent work from start to cleanup. Cutting down trees to trimming, hey we're careful not to damage surrounding areas. Very professional and would use them again

reviews.author: Marissa Sircy
reviews.text: JBS just removed a large pine tree that was up against our fence with our pool on the other side. I don’t think a single branch landed in our pool. They were amazing, I think we had 8+ guys here which made us feel very safe that nothing would happen to our property. They left the yard very clean too. I highly recommend and will only be using them moving forward. 5 stars!

reviews.author: Kathy Moravek
reviews.text: Excellent service from start to finish. Friendly and professional. They worked so smoothly as a team. They know their job. They cleaned up everything! I would highly recommend to anyone. They removed dead branches and trimmed the tree nicely.

reviews.author: Ausra Petronyte
reviews.text: Could not be happier with service received- from the first phone call, day of the estimate and the work . Everyone is very polite, good attitude and professional. And the price is definitely the best in Ocean county! From the jungle to the open and bright back yard in just a few hours, as promised - great job!

reviews.author: Paola Pascarella
reviews.text: These guys were the best. Had trees down from a storm. Came in with 7 guys, tons of equipment and got the job done. Very respectful and minimized any further damage. Said they would be here at 8 and got here at 7:45. Can t say enough good things about this company. Ryan is a man of his word

reviews.author: Mary Colberg
reviews.text: I have a couple of tall oaks, maples, a big old Kwanzan cherry, purple leaf plum, and crepe myrtles that need undercutting and cleaning up, and they are like my babies. JBS is the only company to do exactly what I need, with precision. They don't chop everything to bits (I've had that in the past by other companies), and I still have cool shady spots without the lawnmower guy poking his eye out. Second year with them and I will never let anyone else touch my trees. Mary - Toms River

reviews.author: Dylan L
reviews.text: I had JBS Tree Service come out to remove a large number of trees on my property, and they did an absolutely excellent job. It was a very big project, and from start to finish Ryan was professional, accurate, and honest about everything. His crew worked hard and managed to get the entire job done in just one day, which was impressive. The results came out fantastic, and I couldn’t be happier with the work. I highly recommend JBS Tree Service to anyone looking for reliable, top-quality tree work.

reviews.author: cheryl feigenbaum
reviews.text: WE are so happy with JBS. They did an amazing job! the men were friendly and efficient. They did an amazing clean up and our yard looked wonderful. Also Ryan and Cara were a pleasure to work with. We highly recommend them and would use them again in a minute. Thank you JBS for a job well done.

reviews.author: John McFarlane
reviews.text: Very professional crew. They definitely go the extra mile to keep a happy customer. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rosemary Morehouse
reviews.text: I highly recommend Jbs after a tree falling in my driveway, calling them their quick service. Their expertise took away the tree and stump job done so neatly and professionally you would never know there was a tree there. if I could get 10 stars, I would.

reviews.author: Ann Mancuso
reviews.text: Excellent service. Prompt and all the guys were very professional. They cleaned up and left the yard better than I anticipated.

reviews.author: Bryan Buccella
reviews.text: Amazing Crew, arrived perfectly on time. Completed the job with excellent professionalism. 4 pine trees 4 stumps in 2 hours and 52 min. Cleaned up like they were never there. I would recommend this group again and again.

reviews.author: Kathy Clayton
reviews.text: Friendly, easy to work with. Guys did an awesome job. Left the yard looking great Huge difference, reasonable price. Very happy

reviews.author: Donna Brown
reviews.text: Ryan was very thorough when he came to give us an estimate. And he was prompt in responding to our request. The work the guys did was excellent as was the cleanup. Very reasonable price too! Couldn’t be happier

reviews.author: David Ratkowski
reviews.text: For tree services in Ocean and Monmouth counties, JBS Tree Service is second to none. My experience with them was exceptional, and I highly recommend their team. From the initial estimate with Justin to the project scheduling with Kara, their knowledge and professionalism were evident. Their pricing is also outstanding, making them an excellent value. The crew was punctual and immediately got to work, demonstrating remarkable skill while removing several large oak and mulberry trees and protecting a valuable maple. They were meticulous with their work and paid careful attention to adjacent properties to prevent any damage from debris. Upon completion, the cleanup was thorough, reflecting the crew's pride in their work. The final result is a much more open property that receives more sunlight. I will certainly be a returning customer for future projects.

reviews.author: Lee Hofmann (Mjrtarget)
reviews.text: JBS did a wonderful job taking down the big oak trees in my yard that were dying. They were very professional and friendly. It was a pleasure watching them work, they operated extremely well together. They cleaned up all the leaves and branches and it looks like we never even had trees in those spots. I highly recommend calling and using JBS Tree Experts. Wonderful job JBS, Thank you!!!!

reviews.author: Alina Acosta
reviews.text: JBS is the best tree service! We have had them come to the house 4 times within the last three years! They knew exactly what the project entailed, they cleaned the entire working area and were polite. A key thing about companies is when they listen to customers - and they did. We are pleased with the outcome. The company had great communication through out the process. I highly recommend JBS.

reviews.author: Andrew LaMantia
reviews.text: We have used JBS on 3 separate occasions. Our first experience was a few years back when they took down a huge dead tree and trimmed some limbs very high off the ground to provide more light to the lawn. Our second and third occasions were just this summer (2025). All three experiences were excellent. Ryan suggested and used creative methods to keep the heavy machinery from tearing up the lawn which was greatly appreciated. Eric and his crews did excellent work as well and the clean ups are meticulous. Highly recommend JBS for any job.

reviews.author: Maria Haas Guenther
reviews.text: We have used this JBS service several times over the years. They have given care advice serviced our trees, taking giant limbs down without damaging a thing! Fair pricing, careful and thorough. They arrived on schedule , did a great job and cleaned up. FANTASTIC!

reviews.author: danielle collins
reviews.text: JBS tree service was extremely professional, reasonably priced, honest, punctual and clean up all the debris from the 2 trees I had removed from the property. I used them in the past and will continue using and recommending them.

reviews.author: Michael Permuko
reviews.text: One tree to cut down and a bigger tree to trim. JBS did a fantastic job. From the estimate to the final cutting day, punctuality, pricing and cleanliness. I’m an extremely satisfied customer. It was very interesting to watch the guys in action. THANK YOU JBS!

reviews.author: Marguerite Tricarico
reviews.text: Very pleased, once again for another tree removal job. Always 5 Stars for the quick, kind & professional work and at a lower comparable price. Thank you Guys for a great clean up in taking the large branch that’s been in my yard for a long time.

reviews.author: Kelli McCourt
reviews.text: JBS is amazing! In just over an hour, they removed two large pine trees and the stumps from our backyard. They were polite, efficient and cleaned up after. We are already planning to hire them for another few trees. Can't say enough about this company!

reviews.author: Brent Slatas
reviews.text: They are true professionals. They have a great crew with all the necessary equipment to do the job right. And when the job was done the area was left clean and the price was more than fair. Great people to deal with.

reviews.author: Bill Caffyn
reviews.text: Great job from JBS from start to finish. Ryan was on time, went over all of our needs, concerns and options before coming up with a very competitive quote. The office followed up on a timely basis. Nick and crew were right on time on our date and it was amazing watching how well the crew worked together. Job was done as described and they cleaned up to make it like they were never there. Will definitely recommend and reuse JBS again.

reviews.author: Veronica Suleski
reviews.text: What a great experience from start to finish. From when I called for an appt how fast they were able to get in , the p ice is very reasonable , to the actual day of the job !! They were out there in the rain cutting down the trees ! Blew my mind ! They kept everything very neat and clean as they could be ! I will definitely be recommending them to others and calling them for any future jobs !!

reviews.author: Joseph Garone
reviews.text: Highly recommend. Very fair pricing and great workmanship. Had a large oak taken down, the stump grinded, and vertical trimming up my fence line. Crew worked quickly and cleaned up everything. Would 100% use again.

reviews.author: Walt Walko
reviews.text: "Stella" left us searching for a tree service and many companies offered services but no estimates. It was refreshing that Justin personally answered our call and immediately surveyed the situation. He answered all our questions, provided us with a detailed estimate, and was reassuring during a trying time. During removal, JBS was professional, efficient, and did an amazing clean-up. JBS is and will be highly recommended to anyone needing a reliable tree service.

reviews.author: Jess S
reviews.text: Fair price for removal of a giant oak tree. Crew was quick, efficient, and CLEAN! They did not leave one leaf or destroy my grass. JBS has become our neighborhood go-to. Very easy to schedule.

reviews.author: Dennis Veltre
reviews.text: Needed some large branches trimmed that were hanging over the roof due to insurance company request. JBS did a great job at a reasonable price. They showed up on time and were easy to contact and kept me updated along the way. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Sophia Karina
reviews.text: We were quoted on August 28th but were told that there would be a 2 week wait. We patiently waited the 2 weeks and on the day of the tree removal, the company canceled 25 min before the appointment due to inclement weather that did not happen until the late afternoon. Our appointment was at 8:30am. They also told us that no one is in the office so we couldn’t schedule a new appointment at the same time that they canceled our appointment. We waited 24 hours and called back today to be rescheduled to be given a date that is well over 1 week away. When we told them that this date would not work for us and when offering 3 other dates, we were told that because we were canceled we do not have priority to get the job done.

reviews.author: ron hrabal
reviews.text: Fast Professional Quality Service at an Affordable Price Would Recommend to Anyone! Best In Ocean County

reviews.author: John Lanza
reviews.text: So very pleased with JBS. Showed up on the day scheduled and they came prepared! They have all the right equipment for an efficient job. Took down a large canopy tree and another tall bush. Grinded the stump and protected our house and windows from flying debris and stones. You can imagine the clean up involved but the crew is a well-oiled machine and cleanup was great. Each of the five person crew knew their jobs and worked well together. Nick supervised the crew and all were very respectful. Give JBS a try!

reviews.author: Michel Wurmbrand
reviews.text: These guys were great. Made a tough job look easy. Not only did they do a great clean up making that part of my yard better than before, they also cleaned my neighbors yard when some branches fell there . I highly recommend JBS, clean, professional and friendly.

reviews.author: Marie T.
reviews.text: Had two trees removed that were very close between my house and the neighbor. The crew of 6 guys worked very efficiently to remove the trees carefully, put down plates to protect the grass as much as possible, and cleaned up all the branches and stumps. I would definitely recommend JBS.

reviews.author: Mar Mul
reviews.text: They did a wonderful job trimming my cherry tree out front and they also did a great job in cleaning up. I would definitely recommend them and will use them again.

reviews.author: JOE McGOVERN
reviews.text: These workers are amazing. Very coordinated on all aspects. Great Job. Very fast. Cleaned up afterwords. Cannot rave enough how good they work. An all out team effort. They work in the dark when they want to get the job done on time. Highly recommended. I would use them over and over again. Very safety conscious. AAA WORK. THANK YOU TO ALL FOR ATTACKING OUR TREE. JoeMc

reviews.author: Rikki Eckman
reviews.text: Their team arrived earlier than expected which was great. We were having a maple removed from the front yard. Our yard is mostly stones so they had a barrier in place when doing the stump grinding to protect our home and windows. They took away all the debris, filled the hole and took away the excess as well as raking our stones back in place. It looks as if there were never a tree there. They were fast and efficient taking down the tree and clearing everything away in about half an hour. We will definitely use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Gus Revuelta
reviews.text: I had JBS trim some very large branches hanging into my neighbors yard and grind down an old stump. They came with trucks, grinder, chipper and 6 guys. They worked fast and safely. Very professional and obviously very experienced. They cleaned up so well, you would never know any work had been done. They were done in under 2 hours and very reasonably priced. They came recommended by a friend who used them and I too will recommend them. In fact, next week they’re taking down a huge tree for my sister-in-law.

reviews.author: Tom Karagiannakis
reviews.text: We use JBS for all of our tree related work. They are always professional, prompt and go above and beyond to satisfy the project needs. Highly recommend this team!

reviews.author: Stacey Henderson
reviews.text: Highly recommended. They came out and gave a fair estimate, right in line with the others I had gotten. They scheduled the work within a few weeks, showed up as scheduled. They quickly completed all the work. They cleaned up and then had me assess the work that was completed to make sure I was happy. Everything was done to my satisfaction . The whole process was seamless. They were professional all the way around, from initial estimate to speaking to those in the office and those that came out to do the work. if you need tree work, I would definitely reach out. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Marie Page
reviews.text: A VERY big shout out to the jbs crew! Had several very large trees cut down. They were very professional,paid close attention to safety and detail and my yard was left absolutely spotless. Highly highly recommend this company

reviews.author: Vicki LaPinta
reviews.text: This company is great! I just had 4 trees taken down today. One was 40 feet tall and 2 ft wide! They showed up early, removed the trees, and ground down the stump. They were efficient and respectful of my property. They cleaned everything up and took it with them. Very fair price. They have done work for me a few times in the past. I am very happy and highly recommend JBS!!

reviews.author: Peter Pettrow
reviews.text: We have used JBS Tree Experts four times now. The service they provided was top notch. Real professional from start to finish. We highly recommend them you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Willow Dog
reviews.text: JBS tree experts did an excellent job on my home. They did everything I asked for and more. Last year they removed lots of trees in my back yard. I was extremely happy with there work and had them removed 15 trees at my daughter's home. There pricing was extremely fair. I recommend them 100 percent.

reviews.author: judy dimattina
reviews.text: I have used this company 3 times and each time the work is very well done, and in a timely manner. The clean up is always done with a smile. The owners and office stay in touch and are awesome to deal with. The price is very fair. Don’t hesitate to contact JBS Tree Experts!!!

reviews.author: J dub
reviews.text: Contacted them for an estimate about a tree I was looking to get removed. From first meeting to scheduling to the actual removal could not have asked for a better experience. On time fairly priced and very professional during the work. Took great care to make sure nothing went wrong. If I need anything in the future they are the only ones I will be calling. Thanks again, John W.

reviews.author: sharon trufolo
reviews.text: Called JBS Tree Service to have a tree taken down at our rental house, Justin's crew were there the next week. They did a fantastic job, also had them trim a tree in the front yard. They are fast and neat!! Highly recommend them

reviews.author: Lauren LeFante
reviews.text: This the second time I have used JBS services. From beginning to end their quality of work has been superb!! My trees look great and clean up was fantastic. I won’t use anyone else. Oh, by the way their prices are very reasonable!!!!!!

reviews.author: Steven Baliva
reviews.text: Bought a new home and wanted to remove a number of trees in the front of the property. They came out and gave an estimate. I booked them and the follow up was great. While there I decided I wanted some other bushes removed and they did it with no issues. Clean up was great and the cost super reasonable. Definitely will utilize them again!

reviews.author: Thomas Shatel
reviews.text: This company is a well oiled machine. I had two huge pines cut down and trimming done. I couldn’t be more pleased with there professional work. Great communication from the beginning to the end of project. I would highly recommend JBS to friends and family. Thanks again for a difficult job well done!!

reviews.author: Ashley Gutierrez
reviews.text: JBS has been at my house numerous times to remove trees. Ryan and his crew are phenomenal. Would highly recommend these guys!!! Thank you JBS for always doing a job well done!

reviews.author: c pilato-iannacone
reviews.text: I recently used JBS for the second time, and am very happy with their work. They are affordable, organized and every employee I communicated with were pleasant and personable. Thank you Ryan and staff!

reviews.author: Geo A
reviews.text: WOW! Professional crew that is just awesome! Two trees taken down with great efficiency. Our property was so very well cared for during the process. Forget your other tree service and HIRE THESE GUYS.

reviews.author: Joel Day
reviews.text: JBS took down a large pine tree located about 10 feet behind my house and also close to my neighbors house. They were very careful in taking down each large branch and hauling them away for grinding. Then they ground the stump and raked the area. I was very impressed by the crew and how quickly but carefully they worked and how well they cleaned up!

reviews.author: Michael Petrocelli
reviews.text: These guys definitely a five star.Had me scheduled for Tuesday needed to move me to the following Monday because of equipment issues last week. I spoke with them I had to have it done today they did everything in there power to get me done. They got to me by the end of the day and finished my job. A+ Nick was great though the whole process. I highly recommend JBS THE BEST!!

reviews.author: Robin V
reviews.text: They did a great job clearing out trees overlying our house and in our backyard. Very fairly priced, and fantastic service and responsiveness, big thank you to Ryan and his team. Would highly recommend and hire again in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Dan Doherty
reviews.text: JBS tree service all 3 keys you want! -Great pricing -Professional and courtesy workers -Quick workers Strongly recommend them!!

reviews.author: kathy mohr
reviews.text: We bought our house last year and it had two gigantic trees hanging over the house with a lot of big, giant, dead branches, I happen to see one of their trucks in my neighborhood so I called them and got a price quote. They did an amazing job with these trees, so I called them again this year to have three trees removed from my yard Once again, the service was fantastic, I got a great quote, and on the day of the tree removal, the crew came. They were very courteous, very professional. They took the trees down, very quickly, took care of the stumps. My yard was cleaner when they left then before they got there. I would recommend the service to everyone. Thank you JBS for doing a great job and thank you to the ladies in the office. They were very pleasant to deal with. Kathy Limone 9 Boxwood

reviews.author: Diane Kerns
reviews.text: JBS removed a tree and ground two stumps on my property on 5/31/23. Professional courteous service. Mike is great and oversees all the work at the job site. They did a tremendous job and were fast and neat. Fair estimate for the work that was done. I will definitely use them again, and highly recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Eric D.
reviews.text: We have used J.B.S. Tree Service twice and both projects exceeded expectations. Nick was our point of contact for both projects and listened to what we wanted. Offered a professional opinion. We had a detailed plan for both projects. The J.B.S. Tree team, the communication and coordination with Kara in the office along with Nick made life very easy for us regarding our expectations. Five stars start to finish.

reviews.author: keith baker
reviews.text: By far the best tree company around! From the secretary in the office to the guys doing the work everyone was extremely professional. I had the pleasure of dealing with Ryan who came out to give me my quote. Great guy and a great company. HIGHLY RECCOMENDED A+!

reviews.author: Deborah Cook
reviews.text: Quoted a great competitive price, the job was completed exceptionally. I had concerns about the tree stump grinding and removal after a bad experience in the past with another contractor, but with JBS I highly recommend these guys!

reviews.author: Raymond Allender
reviews.text: I don't write many reviews, however my experience with JBS was great. Nick quoted me a very competitive price, they showed up on time. Everyone was very professional. But above all, their work is exceptional. Had a huge tree in my back yard and now you cant tell it was ever there. Grinded the stump well below the surface and cleaned up so you couldn't tell they were there. Will definitely be using again. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Barbara Fritz
reviews.text: We spoke with many tree removal companies before deciding on JBS Tree Experts. What we liked from the start is their positive, professional attitude. Their prices were the best and showed up on the day they were supposed to start, at the time they said they would come. We had four big oak trees that were removed and JBS did a fantastic job with the removal, grinding and cleanup. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Daniel Tromsdorff
reviews.text: J.B.S. Tree experts did a amazing job removing a large tree I had in my front yard as well as grinding the stump. The whole process from the phone call inquiry to the final clean up of debris was extremely professional. The workers were fast, meticulous, safe and clean. The price was the best out of five different estimates I had received. If you are in need of tree service I highly recommend J.B.S!!!!

reviews.author: Melissa Smith
reviews.text: We just had JBS at our house to remove several large oak trees, they did everything we had asked for and beyond. Most of the trees were hanging over our house and they did an amazing job taking them down. They left our property cleaner than it was before. They even cleaned off both our roof and our neighbors roof. They grinded the stumps almost a whole foot below grade, which will make it much easier for us to pour our concrete walkway. They also did a few extra small tasks at no charge. They are without a doubt fast, efficient and affordable. I would highly recommend JBS to anyone who needs their trees taken care of.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: Would highly recomend!!! The crew came out and removed my tree in a timely fashion and made the yard look like they were never even there if you need any tree work would definetly recomend giving them a call.

reviews.author: Terry Malone Corino
reviews.text: We are very pleased with the extensive oak tree trimming work that the JBS Tree Experts LLC team did for us yesterday! Ryan Suveg came 2 weeks ago and gave us a very reasonable estimate. He is very knowledgeable & responsive, an excellent communicator. Kara in the office was great as well, and she got us a good work date quickly & did paperwork/billing/phoning. The JBS crew was friendly, and they did amazing tree climbing/trimming, cherrypicker operating & trimming. Respectful of customers, neighbors & property. Clean-up was meticulous, complete. We will definitely call JBS again for any future tree services & we highly recommend them. Our neighbors across the street saw what JBS was doing on our property, and asked if JBS would trim a few of their oak limbs, too, same day. JBS took care of theirs quickly & efficiently, too. Now all of our oaks are safe. Amazing! Thanks again! - Terry & Lon Corino

reviews.author: Glen Binger
reviews.text: These guys were absolutely fantastic! We had a massive tree come down during a recent storm that destroyed our fence/patio, in a new home we closed on just a week prior. Budget was already stretched super thin and insurance was playing their games, but Ryan and his crew were totally understanding and did everything they could to help us. Kind, friendly, knowledgeable; professional in every sense. Plus, the job was absolutely spotless upon cleanup. I highly recommend JBS --- a Google Review cannot express that enough!

reviews.author: Jean Sullivan
reviews.text: JBS is the tree company to hire. Having lived in Whiting for almost 30 years, we have used 2 other tree companies prior to JBS. Neither came close to the expertise this company displayed. Prompt, efficient, and very hard working employee's! You will not regret hiring this company. Will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: James R
reviews.text: JBS came in and got the job done. Got multiple quotes and knew after meeting with the owner that he was the right guy for the job. I had multiple trees removed off a busy road and JBS handled the project like it was a walk in the park. Hands down the BEST money can buy! Trust me when I say, this is the company you want to hire if you care anything about your investment. Thanks again JBS and I will be calling you again for more work! Truly a great experience.

reviews.author: joseph mcgrath
reviews.text: My mother in Holiday City just had to, unfortunately, have an over 50 year old tree in her front yard removed by JBS. Cannot express enough the professionalism, courtesy and overall good character of JBS. From the office staff to the owner to the laborers they are a top notch group of people. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Mary Monte
reviews.text: This company was perfect from start to finish! I spoke with Ryan who was nothing less then Perfect. He Was friendly,knowledgeable, Reasonable! I had 5 trees removed, stumps grinded down And some trim work in other trees. The crew that came to my house did everything right. They put my fence back together perfectly,they cleaned up everything!!!They did More than a great job! Thank you very much for a job well done!! I Will recommend you company very highly!

reviews.author: Margo Buttino
reviews.text: Second time we used JBS they do exactly what you ask for and the cleanup is great. They arrive on time and very easy to deal with would highly recommend!

reviews.author: A Better Look Home Inspections
reviews.text: These guys are true professionals. Estimate was given quickly, work was completed unsupervised. Came home to a clean yard, the guys did exactly was discussed with no deviation. It was wonderful to hire a contractor that does what they promise at the agreed on price in a timely manner. Thanks JBS Tree Experts, I will recommend you to my clients.

reviews.author: Catherine Foster
reviews.text: After attempting to contact several tree companies for estimates JBS Tree Experts responded immediately. Nick, the representative for the company was on time to give me the estimate. After quoting me the cost, I looked no further. I knew I couldn’t do any better. This job was done in a professional manner and my yard looks great. I would recommend that you call this company first. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: John Hammell
reviews.text: I've used JBS on a few occasions and would not hesitate to use them or refer others to use them in the future. The crews are always timely, professional, clean and courteous. I've been pleased with their prices too.

reviews.author: Jesse Anstett
reviews.text: They were punctual, fast, effective, and very reasonable. I am very happy with the job they did and you can’t even tell there was a massive tree there only hours before.

reviews.author: razlo76
reviews.text: I made an appointment before Easter and got an estimate to cut down some small trees. The guy was supposed to come on a Friday never came. I waited a week and called. He said he got tied up and would come out the following Friday, no Call no-show. I called again and reached the receptionist who said I was never on file. She stated there was a misunderstanding and that she would call me later on the week. No phone call was made. I followed up one last time, again was blown off. Here we are in May and nothing. I called a different company and got a cheaper price. My trees are gone now, job completed in 1 hr. Would not recommend

reviews.author: Mike Plescia
reviews.text: This is absolutely the best company in the area for tree work. We got 5 estimates to remove a dozen trees & stumps on our property and JBS was by far the most reasonably priced. Ryan and everyone else on the crew at JBS is fantastic. Very professional and efficient, they ended up cleaning up our property and leaving it nicer than before. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: michael
reviews.text: JBS was my fourth quote, and only at the recommendation of my fence guy. They came in decently under the other 3. Ryan came out same day, had a great attitude. His team arrived exactly on time, and my trees were gone before lunch. Great experience with JBS.

reviews.author: CJ DJ
reviews.text: I've been using JBS since 2016. The whole family is kind, courteous and professional. This previous time I called, they trimmed several trees and removed a dead tree in a hard to reach area. It's amazing to see the crew carefully remove limbs without damaging the surroundings. I can add them to my most trusted contractors list. Thank you very much.

reviews.author: Linda Kenny
reviews.text: Justin and his crew are amazing. I have used them several times and have always been pleased. They are like a well oiled machine when you watch them do their job~~so professional in how they get the job done. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Gary Andrew
reviews.text: JBS IS THE BEST OF THE BEST!! From Nick who set the job up, to Kara who handled the appointment to the entire crew who did the work!! Can’t say enough about em! Any future work will be from them! Gary, Toms River

reviews.author: Anna Livingston
reviews.text: After calling a few places for quotes to remove a tree in the yard, JBS came in at the best price ($400 less than other places) WITH stump removal also! The tree hung over power lines and was very tall, and the removal was done in only two hours. Great price and great service! I highly recommend them to anyone who needs a tree removed!

reviews.author: Petra Mckeon
reviews.text: Once again JBS shows why they are the best tree service. They came out gave me a solid quote and showed up the day they promised. The crew were all professionals. I don’t even get any more quotes when it comes to tree service.

reviews.author: Richard Belesky
reviews.text: I had them come out to trim two oak trees. The hydraulic line on the bucket truck burst spraying hydraulic fluid all over my brand new cabana, my cars and house causing 3k worth of damage. I understand accidents happen. The owner Justin now wants to bargin with me on paying me back for the repairs I had to make. Very unprofessional. Would definitely recommend staying away from this business.

reviews.author: Brooke Sherman
reviews.text: So happy with JBS Tree Experts!! We dealt with Justin initially, who was great, very professional right from the get-go. His crew removed a bunch of low-hanging tree limbs which were in danger of falling onto our roof. The end result is beautiful, you can’t tell anything was cut at all, just looks natural with no limbs over the roof. Cost was very reasonable, basically industry-standard, and we felt these guys went above and beyond to make it look perfect. Justin even did a follow-up inspection of the job to make sure we were satisfied (again, nothing but professional.) Thanks JBS! We’ll definitely recommend you to others.

reviews.author: George S
reviews.text: I hired JBS TREE Experts LLC. to take down and remove a 100+ foot dead oak. Ryan offered me a fair price. They were here at 8:00 this morning. They left About 11:00. My property is spotless. Quick, friendly and professional. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Carol L
reviews.text: Crew arrived on time and worked non stop. Everything finished and cleaned up in now time at all. I will recommend them to who ever needs tree work done. Very happy with this company!

reviews.author: Doreen Hynes
reviews.text: I have used JBS Tree Service on several occasions and I found Justin and his team to be very professional, informative with tree guidance (which I know nothing about), fair in price, responsive to any questions, and the return calls were prompt. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Sarah Kelber
reviews.text: JBS was excellent!!! I would highly recommend and will definitely be using again. The guys were prompt, worked efficiently and very friendly!!

reviews.author: Bonnie Patterson
reviews.text: JBS gave me a fair estimate, showed up when they said they would and did an outstanding job. They left the area so clean you would not even have known they were there. I highly recommend JBS and will only use them for any future needs I may have .

reviews.author: Anna Reiss
reviews.text: I called around to get a couple quotes to get two stumps grinded out of my backyard. JBS came in the cheapest of the quotes. They were responsive to my scheduling needs and the ladies in the office were extremely helpful. I knew they would be doing the job while I was at work, so I was a bit nervous of what I would find when I got home. They left my backyard exactly the way they found it! Aside from the stumps being gone, you would never have known they were there. I couldn't have been happier with JBS and would absolutely use them in the future!

reviews.author: Ryan Mahoney
reviews.text: This is our second time using JBS and I have to say, they're really top notch. Affordable, professional, and they do excellent work. We just had our flower beds mulched by the landscaper, and decided AFTER that to have a large dying shrub removed. Not too bright on our part, I know. When I say large, I mean it is over 7' tall. I thought for sure I'd come home to wood chips all over the ground from the stump grinding, but shockingly none at all. It's like the shrub was never even there; that it just disappeared. The mulched flower bed doesn't look disturbed at all. Was extremely impressed and appreciative of the work that was done. If you're looking for a local tree service, look no further than JBS Tree Experts! They're the best!

reviews.author: nick soscia
reviews.text: The guys took my tree down, grind the stump, and cleaned everything up for a killer price. Would highly recommend JBS.

reviews.author: Angelo Dirodrico
reviews.text: They did a excellent job,!! From the cutting down our oversized Oak trees to the excellent clean up. I recommend JBS Tree Services to anyone who needs them . Diffenitly Highly recommend!!!!

reviews.author: Sharon Hartwell
reviews.text: I needed large evergreens cut back. Not only did they do a great job but they showed up when they said they would! They cleaned up so well you could not even tell they had cut back the trees. But what is most impressive is they return your call and they come when they say they’re going to. That is rare in this day. I found the estimate to be more than reasonable. I would definitely use them again, and I’ve already given their name out to my friends.

reviews.author: Jackie Bermudez
reviews.text: They were very respectful of the property. Made sure we were satisfied with the job. Responded quickly. I would highly recommend and would use them again.

reviews.author: James Higgins
reviews.text: This was the absolute worst experience that I have ever had. They never came to the house to do the estimate that was given. They refused to do the work that they were contracted for and didn't even complete the job. After calling and complaining I was told he would come back out to complete the job and that it was his fault for not putting it on the paperwork, although he was here when the work was being done? When he did come back out he trimmed a few of the low-hanging limbs but only what he could reach from the ground, one of which hit my car (i offered to move it beforehand). After cutting a handful of tiny limbs he left. So the contracted work is still unfinished. I was charged $1600 for an hour of work, but none of the concerns which I contracted to have addressed were touched. Highway robbery. Along with the trash they left in my yard as well. Would not recommend.

reviews.author: Marguerite Todaro
reviews.text: If I could rate them a 10 they definitely deserve it. They are prompt, removed a 25 year maple tree . The men are hard workers and conscious of your property, I am impressed with the removal, cleanup and workmanship. Thank you Ryan it has been a great experience!!

reviews.author: Mario DelleFave
reviews.text: Ryan and his team took down a lot of trees for me. They did it all in a day and were very professional. I was amazed by how quick they were. I would highly recommend them for any tree/shrub removal or stump grinding. Thanks again to JBS.

reviews.author: Steph L
reviews.text: Mike came out within 20 minutes of calling for an estimate. Thoroughly explained the cause of our dead tree. Scheduled the removal date and my tree was gone within less than a week of getting my quote! The tree crew arrived on time. Watching them work felt like watching poetry in motion, each guy had a role and harmoniously worked together; quickly yet safely. They cleaned up every piece of debris related to the tree removal. And last but not least, they offered to level out a few empty holes in my yard with the mulch from the stump removal. This is a class act company that I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Tanuja Gutti
reviews.text: Horrible service JNS scheduled time for cutting tree and I took time off my work ( lost revenue) and they did not show up and multiple calls and no reply or no one picked up the phone either. No communication at all, I wouldn’t recommend this company to anyone

reviews.author: herb glass
reviews.text: Great company! Personal touch from beginning to end. Price was extremely reasonable and they took the time to clean up the job site to spotless. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Phil Baum
reviews.text: Great job by JBS tree service. Very professional workers.Reasonably priced and replaced all outside furniture etc along with a great clean up job.I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Helen Mcgrail
reviews.text: Boy, was I had! We hired JBS Tree "Expert" in Sept 2019 to remove a very small, dead tree and grind down the stump;. They did an OK job on the tree removal; not so great on stump grinding. We had them come back in Nov 2019 for a much larger 2nd job of trimming down 2 large trees and cutting back all the over-hanging branches from my neighbors yard into mine. On the morning of the scheduled appointment Justin, one of the owners, came by to tell his crew who arrived separately what was supposed to be done and then sped off. I was just recovering from eye surgery so I was unable to adequately access the "completed" job but on (literally) blind faith I paid over $2200 to his crew. In mid-Dec 2019 I texted Justin to come by and see the contracted work which had not been completed. He promised he would come by the following week---never happened! I texted him again and he said he didn't have a chance but was, at that time, in Vermont until the end of Jan 2020. In the end of Jan 2020 I texted Justin again to find out if he was back and could the job be completed as contracted. He told me that he would not be back until mid-Feb 2020 but he had come by before he went to Vermont(evidently not remembering or even bothering to look back to what he had previously texted in Dec 2019-such attention to detail speaks for itself) and that I could PAY he to complete the job he already charged me $2200+ for! I texted him again mid-Feb 2020 with photos of uncompleted work and have yet to hear back. JBS Tree "Experts" may, I repeat MAY,. be OK for the smallest of jobs but they are not to be trusted with anything larger jobs which require real experts and integrity. Justin was by no means the least expensive estimate I got but he looked "trustworthy" so I hired him. Mia Culpa!

reviews.author: Joseph Amoroso
reviews.text: I have always used JBS and will continue to do so. They pay attention to clean up detail, work is completed on time and very professional

reviews.author: Marc Reyes
reviews.text: JBS was the first tree service i called and I'm glad idid JBS was very professional they were on time and took down two trees and cleaned up everything in a timely manner I was very satisfied with everything I would use there service again definitely.

reviews.author: Toni Del Mauro
reviews.text: What a professional tree service. Sean, was incredible he ran my job and made sure that everything we discussed during our estimate was addressed. This was my second time using JBS and will use them again. Fully insured and great quality work.

reviews.author: Laura Westmoreland
reviews.text: Pros: -They had more availability than other companies -Good price -Trees came down successfully Cons: -They were not able to schedule a specific date, but gave me a week-long range. At the end of that week, they told me it would actually be the following Friday. No big deal, but would have preferred sticking to a specific date. -They also agreed to leave us a pile of wood, but did not. Again, no big deal, but additional miscommunication. -Some damage to our walkway and patio. (Also damage to our grass, but we were expecting that). -Damaged our neighbor's yard after telling us they would not. This is when everything went downhill. At first they were super apologetic and agreed to fix it, but kept putting it off, which was similar to how they delayed doing our original work. If they addressed it quickly as they agreed to all would have gone well. But as time went on our neighbor got more concerned and JBS got a lot less concerned. By the time someone came out it was too late in the fall for grass to grow, and they did not treat our neighbor (who was very angry at this point) well at all. I called and asked to speak to the owner, and the office manager who was originally very helpful told me he probably wouldn't have time to call me back but she would ask. Since it's been a few months now, it's clear he never made time. While I think they do good work removing trees, I would prefer to work with a more reliable company who is willing to talk with their customers.

reviews.author: Michael Hudson
reviews.text: I would highly recommend JBS Tree Experts. They arrived on time, explained what they were going to do, performed their work quickly and efficiently and clean up afterwards was excellent. Crew was courteous and friendly. I will definitely use them again for any tree work I may have.

reviews.author: Amanda Soder
reviews.text: These guys are GREAT!!! Prompt, professional & quick. We had 5 trees removed 3 of which were giant! They arrived at 8am and by noon they’re walking off our property like nothing ever happened! Trees removed, stumps removed, ALL debris removed!! They left our yard cleaner then it was when they arrived. Justin & Sean did our estimate and they were both great!! Made suggestions for things that they thought were immediate must do’s, things to keep in mind for future and options to trim back some of our larger trees if we wanted down the road. Ryan came the day of for the job and everything was done perfectly. He also made suggestions for what to consider for future and/or trees to keep any eye on, what to look out for, etc. The whole team was terrific and you wouldn’t even know we had trees removed in some spots!! A++ and would recommend to anyone in need of tree removal services!

reviews.author: Bernadette F
reviews.text: Great service. Friendly, prompt, fair price. Cleaned up nice after they were done- even the street. Looks great. They’re even coming back to do my next door neighbor’s trees. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Bruce Clarke
reviews.text: JBS Tree Experts were efficient, on time, cleaned up all debris and very affordable. Would highly recommend. Bruce Clarke

reviews.author: Peggy Ryan
reviews.text: Very professional and GREAT service! Easy to deal with.Returns phone calls ASAP! Clean up is unbelievable! Would refer anyone to them.Thanks again for a job done exceptionally well!

reviews.author: Rosie M
reviews.text: Great tree removal company. Ryan and his team did an awesome job removing my trees. They were quick and did a good job cleaning up afterwards. When I look out my window, I can’t even remember where the trees were located.

reviews.author: Blake Cramsie
reviews.text: Owner came out to visit my house two months ago. Nice guy, seems like it was a match made in heaven. Tells me he will be out next week. Office manager calls to say they need another week to get their permits sorted for parking in my town. Another week goes by, no call. I have now called and spoken to the office manager (Cara) at least 5 times and each time she says she needs to speak to owner about scheduling. Then the last time we spoke (well over a week ago), she says they do not think they can do the job now because they are too busy, but once again, needs to speak to the owner and doesn't know why he hasn't called me to discuss. I'm still waiting for that phone call to this date, which i assume is a call to call me they officially resign from the job, but i'm not holding my breathe. This is another case of a small company not investing into their business the right way. Wasted two months of my time instead of just coming clean with it from the beginning. Obviously they have some good reviews here, but this isn't one of them and there are others like it. Really do not like writing anyone a bad review, but unfortunately this one is more than deserved. Sorry guys, do better.

reviews.author: Judi Riley
reviews.text: Awesome team of tree cutters. They came exactly when they said they would. Fast and clean. Yard was cleaned up and everything looked beautiful. Thank you Justin. Will highly recommend you and your brother.

reviews.author: Bobbi L
reviews.text: Did a fantastic job, great customer service, and professional. Showed up with the whole crew and got the job done, cleaned up and put everything back, I wouldn’t even know what happened if I wasn’t missing a tee in the yard. Definitely would recommend.

reviews.author: Deb Zar
reviews.text: JBS Tree Experts were professional, efficient, and priced fairly. I would highly recommend them to anyone needing anything from tree trimming to tree removal. We’ll definitely be using them again.

reviews.author: Renee Thomson
reviews.text: The guys were amazing They took down a huge tree in a small area. I would highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Andrew Roberts
reviews.text: These guys were awesome! And out day after calling for quote. Have a very competitive quote and we’re out within the next week to cut down 5 pine trees.

reviews.author: Laura Holl
reviews.text: Very friendly, quick response and they were efficient and cleaned everything up nicely! Definitely would use them again.

reviews.author: Tracy Connellan
reviews.text: JBS was nothing shy of fantastic. They were prompt in all communications as well as appointments. Very professional, I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lindsay Woodruff
reviews.text: JBS was the first to respond, we're always to their appointments with us well ahead of time and we're competitively priced after looking at 4 to 5 different local companies.

reviews.author: art decco
reviews.text: Most customers do not speak Latin or Slavic languages. There should be at least ONE person on the job that speaks English. ( especially considering the tools & machinery used )

reviews.author: MrMCarr63
reviews.text: Excellent service, very thorough and clean up all the mess. Price was very competitive. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Vincent Claps
reviews.text: Excellent service . The workers are very professional they left my property immaculate . I would highly recommend JBS.

reviews.author: Orlando Rizzolo
reviews.text: Great workers, reliable and knowledgable. Removed an annoying holly tree from my front yard. Cleaned everything. When i returned home it was like there was never a tree there.

reviews.author: Stacy Lynch
reviews.text: Excellent job fair price and cleaned everything up. Very nice family owned business. Would highly recommend

reviews.author: Daniel D
reviews.text: Well priced, quick turnaround, organized and clean. I could not have asked for more and I couldn’t be more pleased.

reviews.author: Joseph Lypowy
reviews.text: JBS has done two jobs for me so far and both times his crew has done a great job! A real professional.
